g.text: Thin lines show all five runs; thick lines show a successful example closest to the cohort median wall time
Scores are sampled at decision ends; stair-step transitions show when a condition was observed, not its exact onset.
Action-step axes omit API waiting and therefore describe physical progress, not wall-clock speed. Task 4: retained run set.
